sql: SELECT json_build_object('cron', (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.start_time) FROM (SELECT d.status, d.return_message, d.start_time, d.end_time FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.jobname = 'evolution-monitor-5min' AND d.start_time > '2026-10-20T21:44:00Z') x), 'http', (SELECT json_agg(y ORDER BY y.created) FROM (SELECT r.id, r.status_code, r.timed_out, r.error_msg, r.created, left(r.content, 400) AS content FROM net._http_response r WHERE r.created > '2026-10-20T21:54:00Z' AND r.content LIKE '%unit%' AND r.content LIKE '%state%') y), 'health', (SELECT json_agg(z ORDER BY z.unit) FROM (SELECT i.unit, h.state, h.bad_checks, h.last_check_at, h.detail->'stuck' AS stuck, h.detail->'alive'->'ok' AS alive_ok FROM provider_health h JOIN wapi_instances i ON h.key = 'instance:' || i.id WHERE i.provider = 'evolution') z)) AS r
